sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry service page directs entry-visa enquiries to the Immigration eVisa service, but contains no ordinary-passport nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For information on visas for entry into Trinidad and Tobago, please visit the e-Visa Portal.

sources.title: Visa Application Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry PDF gives a September 2025 visa procedure, application timing and electronic delivery, but directs readers to a separate country list rather than supply a complete current nationality rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: To find out if you need a visa, consult the list of countries.

sources.title: List of countries whose citizens do not require entry visas for Trinidad and Tobago
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Immigration Division PDF is a positive waiver list. It does not state that omitted ordinary-passport nationalities require a visa or identify an issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the countries listed below do not require visas for entry.

sources.title: Visa Online Services
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration Division page confirms an eVisa service and links the official application endpoint, but publishes no nationality eligibility or issued result for this residual.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Possession of an eVisa does not guarantee your entry into Trinidad and Tobago.

sources.title: Visa & Student Permit
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government portal says an approved eVisa is emailed, but makes eligibility conditional on already being from a visa-required country and has no nationality crosswalk.
sources.supportingExcerpt: eligible foreign nationals from visa-required countries can apply for a Multiple Entry eVisa

sources.title: Trinidad and Tobago eVisa entitlement service
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration Division page links this exact application service. Its normal-TLS replay returned a Cloudflare HTTP 403 before the nationality selector or any eligibility result could be reached.
